children.name: Hypodematium
children.description: Hypodematium — a genus of polypodiopsidas.

children.name: Hypodematium boonkerdii
children.description: The native range of this species is Thailand. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Hypodematium brevipilosum
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Yunnan). It grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Hypodematium chrysolepis
children.description: The native range of this species is Cape Verde. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Hypodematium confertivillosum
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Shandong). It grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Hypodematium crenatum
children.description: The native range of this species is Ethiopia to S. Africa, W. Indian Ocean, Arabian Pen.. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Hypodematium daochengense
children.description: The native range of this species is China (S. Sichuan).

children.name: Hypodematium delicatulum
children.description: The native range of this species is Madagascar. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Hypodematium eglandulosum
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Guizhou, Guangxi) to N. Indo-China. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Hypodematium eriocarpum
children.description: The native range of this species is Afghanistan to Taiwan and New Guinea. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Hypodematium fauriei
children.description: The native range of this species is C. & S. Japan. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Hypodematium fordii
children.description: The native range of this species is S. China. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Hypodematium glabrius
children.description: The native range of this species is Pen. Malaysia (Kelantan), Borneo (Sarawak). It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Hypodematium glabrum
children.description: The native range of this species is China (S. Sichuan, NC. Yunnan). It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Hypodematium glandulosopilosum
children.description: The native range of this species is China (SW. Fujian, S. Henan, S. Jiangsu) to Thailand, S. Korea, S. Japan. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Hypodematium glandulosum
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Guizhou, Hunan).

children.name: Hypodematium gracile
children.description: The native range of this species is E. China.

children.name: Hypodematium hirsutum
children.description: The native range of this species is Indian Subcontinent to China and N. Indo-China, Taiwan. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Hypodematium parvisorum
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Yunnan). It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Hypodematium phegopteroideum
children.description: The native range of this species is Lesser Sunda Is. (Timor). It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Hypodematium ryukyuense
children.description: The native range of this species is C. Nansei-shotō. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Hypodematium sinense
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Shandong).

children.name: Hypodematium squamulosopilosum
children.description: The native range of this species is C. & S. China. It grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Hypodematium subglabrum
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Yunnan). It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Hypodematium truncatum
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Yunnan). It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Hypodematium villosum
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Guangdong).

children.name: Leucostegia
children.description: Leucostegia — a genus of polypodiopsidas.

children.name: Leucostegia amplissima
children.description: The native range of this species is Taiwan to Malesia and New Guinea. It is a lithophyte or epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Leucostegia immersa
children.description: The native range of this species is Trop. & Subtrop. Asia. It is a rhizomatous geophyte or epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Leucostegia pallida
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Myanmar to Pacific. It is a epiphyte.
